reproduction.method: Native production castle_gameplay_draw; front view aimed at source entrance; count emitted DRAW_TRIANGLE commands with view depth greater than 300 to exclude HUD
reproduction.scope: Door-only command submission test; not a physical VGA screenshot or frame-time comparison

source_models: Original source door meshes, source scale 0.25 and composed geo translation [3,0,0]; positions and yaw from original collision/level scripts
material_policy: Source triangle material assignments retained; overlay fallback is two-thirds base RGB, handle fallback [255,208,48], normal shading from existing scene_assets.convert; authored approximations, not sampled textures
performance_claim: None; additional door triangles add rendering work. No sustained frame-time benchmark performed.
